chunks: Commémorate Mary in the Book. When she withdrew from her family to a place in the East

key_terms.مَرْيَمَ: Mary, mother of Jesus, revered in Islam

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Mary's withdrawal from her family?
ai.summary: This verse initiates the narrative of Maryam's spiritual purification, where her withdrawal to an 'eastern' place (often interpreted as the Qibla direction or a dedicated chamber) signifies her exclusive devotion to God amidst her tribe. In Shia exegesis, this seclusion is viewed as a precursor to her miraculous conception, emphasizing her status as a model of piety (Qutb) and the purity of the Ahl al-Bayt lineage.
